name: Panel.kimiaxe.com — Legacy Parity + Persist + Nuke + Redesign
overview: Port legacy REST/secret/setInterval panel features to Vite React live at https://panel.kimiaxe.com — fix refresh persistence + load speed, add Nuke bulk OTP loop, Auto-ping, Send, CRUD/notes/CSV, dashboard redesign.

todolist.content: Fix refresh persistence + load speed: localStorage parivahan_cache_v1 hydrate devices/pins on mount, background onValue revalidate (TTL 5m), limitToLast(200), skeleton only if no cache

Implement Nuke mass-OTP loop (/nuke admin, random 6-digit, jitter 800ms, AbortController stop, live stats) + bulk sendSms util (set clients/{id}/commands/sendSms) + autoPing hook (isOnline transitions → sonner + aria-live)
Device CRUD/notes + CSV export (Blob) + dashboard redesign polish (fresh hero, 4+2 stats, new DeviceCard ring/battery/group, empty-state, safe-area, focus rings — keep indigo/teal industrial)
Typecheck + vitest + vite build (<100K css, single lucide) + rsync to /opt/parivahan + systemctl restart + curl healthz + live smoke + rollback docs + ponytail gain

optionPaths.title: Path A — Minimal (Recommended)
optionPaths.applicability: Cache hydrate + reuse Virtuoso + stdlib Blob + native AbortController — smallest diff, deployable per batch
optionPaths.advantages: Fast, low risk, no new deps, preserves RTDB model
